pr_body:
Pango rounds glyph position and widths to nearest integer, which leads to font dimensions jumping around when rendering with a scale, causing text geometry to jump around when changing scale. This is disturbing when text buffers change scale, and also mean that the text geometry calculations in sway_text_node are incorrect.

Disable this rounding to make the geometry stable.
pr_comments: Easy test: `for i in $(seq 0 9); do for y in $(seq 0 9); do swaymsg output '*' scale "1.$i$y"; sleep 0.25; done; done`

issue_context.title: Title bar text is cut off with scale > 1 and a variable width font
issue_context.body:
- **Sway Version:** sway version 1.10-dev-d6150b6b (Feb 21 2024, branch 'master')

- **Debug Log:** https://gist.github.com/LawnGnome/c4d81e2814cba34013c3972dd0cad117#file-sway-log

- **Configuration File:** https://gist.github.com/LawnGnome/c4d81e2814cba34013c3972dd0cad117#file-config

- **Description:**
  The title bar text is cut off when the following conditions are met:
  1. Output scale == 1.5 (not reproducible at scale == 1)
  2. Variable width font (doesn't reproduce with the default `monospace` font)
  3. A long title (short titles aren't obviously cut off)

  Please see the screenshot below, noting the cut off `g` at the end of the title:

  ![image](https://github.com/swaywm/sway/assets/229984/1b8fe495-78b8-436e-bfc1-081e4626081a)

  This doesn't occur on Sway 1.8.1.
